requirement: /ops/wo keeps every view in the page address: Live Queue filters and the opened WO, Places tab, search, opened place and the Research caps dialog, and Settings as view=settings; a pasted link or F5 reopens the same screen and Back/Forward walks between views

oracle.invariant: 0 failures, 0 skipped. A bare /ops/wo is the Live Queue with every default and writes nothing back. A full queue address and a full Places address round-trip; stage is written as its digit. Each view reads and writes only its own section; Settings writes only view=settings. An invalid value drops only its own field; blank or over-long text is dropped; parameters /ops/wo does not own are kept.
